verdict: Maybe. Babyworks By Swapnil pitched baby jewellery on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Baby jewellery is a traditional gift for births and naming ceremonies, but safety is crucial: materials must be non-toxic and designs must avoid choking risks.
angle: Silver anklets, bracelets and nazariya are common gifts for newborns. Parents want safe, lead-free materials and secure clasps. Gifting occasions such as births, first birthdays and naming ceremonies drive sales.
